segments.translation_en: Is there my letter? Let me see it.

segments.verbatim_es: Eso lo tiene que ver después con el área legal cuando lo contacten. Eso no lo vemos nosotros, lo ve el área legal.
segments.translation_en: You'll have to take that up later with the legal department when they contact you. We don't handle that; the legal department does.

segments.verbatim_es: Tiene que salir del avion, tiene que bajar
segments.translation_en: You have to leave the aircraft, you have to get off.
segments.transcription_notes: reanchored from STG-5.seg-1 (method=text, confidence=high, text_ratio=1.0); offset would pick seg-2 (drift 1.87s)

segments.verbatim_es: Ya activamos seguridad. Igual va a tener que bajar
segments.translation_en: We've already activated security. You're still going to have to get off.

segments.verbatim_es: Yo estoy tranquilísimo porque estoy muy enojado porque perdí mi vuelo, fui humillado.
segments.translation_en: I am completely calm because I am very angry because I lost my flight, I was humiliated.

segments.verbatim_es: En ese caso deve saber como son los procedimentos
segments.translation_en: In that case you should know how the procedures work.
